# Ansible variables

Set per machine in `ansible/inventory/host_vars/<machine>.yml` (start from the commented `example-machine.yml`); secrets go into the Ansible Vault file `ansible/group_vars/all/vault.yml`. Lab-wide defaults live in `ansible/group_vars/all/main.yml`; role variables are defined by each role's `meta/argument_specs.yml`, which Ansible also uses to validate them. Host facts such as `pokus_family` are not variables: the `platform_facts` role derives them from the host profile.

## Lab-wide variables

### `machine_name`

Host name of the machine in the tailnet, in /etc/wsl.conf and in the fingerprint.

- Default: `pokus-lab`

### `lab_mode`

production, or staging for QA environments (own vault, Tailscale tag and signing key; never pairs with a production host).

- Default: `production`

### `lab_provider`

Provider role: auto (the provider preflight detected), baremetal, wsl2 or vm. Any other value than auto must match the detected provider.

- Default: `auto`

### `power_policy`

Power policy on bare metal and VMs: never_sleep (sleep targets masked), lab_session_inhibit (a sleep inhibitor while pokus-lab.target is up) or os_default.

- Default: `lab_session_inhibit`

### `node_role`

What this host runs: full (everything), lab (everything except vLLM) or inference (only the inference stack).

- Default: `full`

### `firewall_backend`

Firewall backend: auto (firewalld if active, else ufw if active, else nftables), nftables, firewalld or ufw.

- Default: `auto`

### `install_nvidia_driver`

NVIDIA driver: auto (install with the family's method), manual (the operator installs it) or skip. Ignored on WSL2, where the driver comes from Windows.

- Default: `auto`

### `allow_community_repos`

Allow community repositories (COPR, OBS home projects, RPM Fusion); recorded in the fingerprint. bootstrap.sh --allow-community-repos does the same.

- Default: `false`

### `grafana_tailscale_serve`

Publish Grafana to the tailnet with `tailscale serve` (never Funnel).

- Default: `false`

### `ssh_extra_allowed_interfaces`

Interfaces besides tailscale0 on which sshd accepts connections.

- Default: `[]`

### `pokus_root`

Root of the research space (BUILD_PROMPT §6.2).

- Default: `/srv/pokus`

### `allow_kernel_updates`

Let automatic security updates update the kernel on bare metal (held by default).

- Default: `false`

### `pokus_tailscale_tags`

Tailscale tag of the host per lab_mode (owner answer E2).

- Default: `{production: 'tag:pokus-lab', staging: 'tag:pokus-qa'}`

### `pokus_groups`

Groups created by users_groups.

- Default:

    ```yaml
    - {name: pokus, system: false, description: all researchers}
    - {name: pokus-admin, system: false, description: researchers with sudo}
    - {name: pokus-gt, system: true, description: may read the ground truth and the catalog}
    - {name: pokus-svc, system: true, description: all service accounts}
    - {name: pokus-exec-clients, system: true, description: may call the executor socket (agent
        and orchestrator)}
    - {name: pokus-gw-clients, system: true, description: may call the gateway's agent socket
        (agent only)}
    ```

### `researchers`

Placeholders (owner answer E1). keys_file is relative to the infra directory; key files are never committed (users/*.pub is excluded by .gitignore).

- Default:

    ```yaml
    - {name: researcher1, admin: true, shell: /bin/bash, keys_file: users/researcher1.pub}
    - {name: researcher2, admin: false, shell: /bin/bash, keys_file: users/researcher2.pub}
    - {name: researcher3, admin: false, shell: /bin/bash, keys_file: users/researcher3.pub}
    ```

### `researchers_removed`

Researchers that left: locked (usermod -L, nologin), never deleted; data kept.

- Default: `[]`

### `break_glass_docker`

Admins that are explicitly allowed into the docker group (logged loudly).

- Default: `[]`

### `service_accounts`

System accounts of the platform services: no login, no password, no SSH keys. pokus-agent never gets pokus-gt, incus, docker or database access.

- Default:

    ```yaml
    - name: pokus-orch
      groups: [pokus-svc, pokus-gt, pokus-exec-clients]
      description: orchestrator
    - name: pokus-agent
      groups: [pokus-svc, pokus-exec-clients, pokus-gw-clients]
      description: agent runtime
    - name: pokus-gw
      groups: [pokus-svc]
      description: LLM gateway
    - name: pokus-exec
      groups: [pokus-svc]
      description: tool executor
    - name: pokus-inject
      groups: [pokus-svc, pokus-gt]
      description: fault injector
    - name: pokus-verify
      groups: [pokus-svc, pokus-gt]
      description: verifier
    - name: pokus-eval
      groups: [pokus-svc, pokus-gt]
      description: evaluator
    ```

### `pokus_service_home`

Parent of the service account homes (/var/lib/pokus/&lt;account&gt;).

- Default: `/var/lib/pokus`

### `pokus_python`

Pinned CPython installed by bootstrap (BUILD_PROMPT §19.3).

- Default: `/opt/pokus/python/bin/python3`

### `pokus_layout`

The research space layout, the single source of truth: the layout role creates exactly these entries, and tools/gen renders them into docs/architecture.md. `path` is relative to pokus_root ("" is pokus_root itself).

- Default:

    ```yaml
    - {path: '', owner: root, group: pokus, mode: '2775', notes: research space root}
    - {path: deploy, owner: root, group: root, mode: '0755', notes: read-only deployments of platform
        and catalog tags}
    - {path: catalog, owner: root, group: pokus-gt, mode: '0750', notes: scenario catalog including
        ground truth}
    - {path: models, owner: pokus-orch, group: pokus, mode: '0755', notes: 'model weights, 0444
        after verification'}
    - path: datasets
      owner: root
      group: pokus
      mode: '2775'
      default_acl: ['group:pokus:rwX']
      notes: shared datasets
    - {path: artifacts, owner: pokus-orch, group: pokus, mode: '0750', notes: 'content-addressed,
        write-once 0440'}
    - {path: reports, owner: pokus-eval, group: pokus, mode: '2775', notes: evaluation reports}
    - {path: images, owner: root, group: pokus-admin, mode: '0750', notes: exported golden image
        tarballs with sha256}
    - path: shared
      owner: root
      group: pokus
      mode: '2770'
      default_acl: ['group:pokus:rwX']
      notes: shared files
    - {path: users, owner: root, group: root, mode: '0755', notes: parent of the per-researcher
        directories}
    - {path: services, owner: root, group: pokus-admin, mode: '0750', notes: 'rendered compose
        and config, never plaintext secrets readable by all'}
    - {path: state, owner: root, group: root, mode: '0755', notes: 'parent of state/<service>/
        (container UID, 0700), created by the service roles'}
    - {path: backups, owner: root, group: root, mode: '0700', notes: local backup staging only}
    ```

### `pokus_layout_user_mode`

Per-researcher directory: users/&lt;name&gt;/ owned by &lt;name&gt;:&lt;name&gt;, mode 0700.

- Default: `0700`

### `pokus_system_layout`

Host paths outside pokus_root (absolute).

- Default:

    ```yaml
    - {path: /etc/pokus, owner: root, group: root, mode: '0755', notes: 'host profile, bootstrap
        state, rendered non-secret config'}
    - {path: /etc/pokus/secrets, owner: root, group: pokus-svc, mode: '0750', notes: rendered
        secrets (files 0640 or per-service 0600)}
    - {path: /var/lib/pokus, owner: root, group: root, mode: '0755', notes: service homes and
        lab state}
    ```

### `pokus_ports`

Listener ports of the lab services (contracts.md#ports).

- Default:

    ```yaml
    {otlp_grpc: 4317, otlp_http: 4318, opa: 8181, incus_https: 8443, grafana: 18700, prometheus: 18701,
      loki: 18702, tempo: 18703, vllm: 18704, gateway_adhoc: 18705, docs_serve: 18706, inference_control: 18710}
    ```

### `pokus_internal_ports`

Loopback ports of lab-internal listeners: exporters, the collectors' own metrics and health checks, Loki's and Tempo's internal servers. Not part of the contract; every observability container uses the host network and binds 127.0.0.1 (BUILD_PROMPT §7.9).

- Default:

    ```yaml
    {collector_metrics: 18720, collector_telemetry: 18721, journald_telemetry: 18722, node_exporter: 18723,
      cadvisor: 18724, postgres_exporter: 18725, gpu_exporter: 18726, tempo_otlp_grpc: 18727,
      loki_grpc: 18728, tempo_grpc: 18729, collector_health: 18730, journald_health: 18731}
    ```

### `pokus_vm_otlp`

Dedicated collector listener for VM targets (contracts.md#telemetry, C4): an address on a dummy interface, reachable only from run networks through the run ACL and the firewall, OTLP gRPC and HTTP on the ports of pokus_ports. Set up only with the vm_targets feature.

- Default: `{interface: pokus-otlp0, address: 198.18.0.1}`

### `pokus_incus_bridge_patterns`

Incus bridges the firewall treats as Incus networks (contracts.md: run networks are named r-&lt;short&gt;; image builds use pokus-build0).

- Default: `[r-*, pokus-build0]`

### `pokus_incus_personal_bridge_patterns`

Bridges of the researchers' personal Incus projects (incusbr-&lt;uid&gt;); unlike run networks they have NAT and an uplink.

- Default: `[incusbr-*]`

### `pokus_source_repo`

The deployer's copy of the Pokus repository, required when the platform or the catalog is enabled (owner answer E3): an SSH URL (read-only deploy key generated on the host) or an anonymous HTTPS URL. Never a URL with credentials.

- Default: `''`

### `pokus_source_known_hosts`

Extra known_hosts lines for an SSH source (GitHub's keys come from versions.lock.yml).

- Default: `[]`

### `require_signed_tags`

Deploy only tags carrying a valid SSH signature of an allowed signer (owner answer E16).

- Default: `false`

### `pokus_allowed_signers`

Allowed signers for signed tags, ssh-keygen allowed_signers lines ("&lt;principal&gt; &lt;key type&gt; &lt;key&gt;").

- Default: `[]`

### `inference_remote_node`

Tailnet name of the paired inference node of a lab node (node_role: lab, BUILD_PROMPT §19.10); set when the nodes are paired.

- Default: `''`

### `inference_lab_node`

Tailnet name of the paired lab node of an inference node (node_role: inference), which receives its telemetry; set when the nodes are paired.

- Default: `''`

### `qa_trusted_keys`

QA public keys trusted for attestations (BUILD_PROMPT §13.10): a list of {name: &lt;file name without .pem&gt;, pem: &lt;PEM public key&gt;}.

- Default: `[]`

## backup

restic backups of pokus_root and /etc/pokus, PostgreSQL dumps, retention and backup metrics.

Entry points: `main` (restic backups of pokus_root and /etc/pokus, PostgreSQL dumps, retention and backup metrics). Role README: `ansible/roles/backup/README.md`.

Variables the role reads from elsewhere:

| Variable | Set by | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `machine_name` | [lab-wide](#machine_name) | Host name recorded in the snapshots; prune and restore select this host's snapshots. |
| `node_role` | [lab-wide](#node_role) | PostgreSQL is dumped on full and lab nodes. |
| `pokus_root` | [lab-wide](#pokus_root) | Research space root; its directories of backup_include are backed up. |
| `pokus_versions` | host_vars | The pinned versions (the restic binary). |

### `backup_repository`

restic repository (default vault_restic_repository); empty means backups are not configured.

- Type: `str`
- Default: `{{ vault_restic_repository | default('') }}`

### `backup_password`

Repository password (default vault_restic_password); written once, changed by rotate.yml.

- Type: `str`
- Default: `{{ vault_restic_password | default('') }}`

### `backup_sftp_known_hosts`

known_hosts lines of the SFTP backup server, required for an sftp repository.

- Type: `list` of `str`
- Default: `[]`

### `backup_include`

Directories below pokus_root that are backed up.

- Type: `list` of `str`
- Default: `[catalog, artifacts, reports, images, datasets, shared, users, backups/pg]`

### `backup_include_models`

Also back up the model weights (re-downloaded and verified on restore otherwise).

- Type: `bool`
- Default: `false`

### `backup_include_state`

Directories of pokus_root/state to back up as well (prometheus, loki, tempo).

- Type: `list` of `str`
- Default: `[]`

### `backup_include_secrets`

Also back up the secret material under /etc/pokus (needs backup_secrets_acknowledged).

- Type: `bool`
- Default: `false`

### `backup_secrets_acknowledged`

Confirms that only the repository's encryption protects backed-up secrets.

- Type: `bool`
- Default: `false`

### `backup_pgdump_keep`

Local PostgreSQL dumps kept.

- Type: `int`
- Default: `7`

### `backup_pgdump_schedule`

OnCalendar of the PostgreSQL dump.

- Type: `str`
- Default: `*-*-* 02:30:00`

### `backup_schedule`

OnCalendar of the restic backup.

- Type: `str`
- Default: `*-*-* 03:00:00`

### `backup_prune_schedule`

OnCalendar of the retention and prune job.

- Type: `str`
- Default: `Sun *-*-* 04:00:00`

### `backup_retention`

Snapshots kept by the prune job (keep-daily, keep-weekly, keep-monthly).

- Type: `dict`
- Default: `{daily: 7, weekly: 4, monthly: 12}`

## base

Base system.

Entry points: `main` (Base system). Role README: `ansible/roles/base/README.md`.

Variables the role reads from elsewhere:

| Variable | Set by | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `allow_kernel_updates` | [lab-wide](#allow_kernel_updates) | On bare metal, let automatic updates install kernels (default false). |

### `base_packages`

Logical package names, mapped per family in vars/&lt;family&gt;.yml.

- Type: `list` of `str`
- Default:

    ```yaml
    [ca_certificates, curl, gpg, jq, git, acl, btrfs_tools, lvm2, thin_provisioning_tools, nftables,
      rsync, tmux, htop, iotop, sysstat, sudo, xz, zstd, bzip2, tar]
    ```

### `base_journald_system_max_use`

journald SystemMaxUse.

- Type: `str`
- Default: `2G`

### `base_journald_system_keep_free`

journald SystemKeepFree.

- Type: `str`
- Default: `4G`

### `base_auto_updates`

Automatic security updates on fixed releases (never on rolling releases).

- Type: `bool`
- Default: `true`

### `base_auto_updates_effective`

Derived; base_auto_updates and not a rolling release.

- Type: `bool`
- Default: `{{ base_auto_updates | bool and pokus_release_model != 'rolling' }}`

### `base_held_package_patterns`

Packages automatic updates never touch (pinned by Pokus).

- Type: `list` of `str`
- Default:

    ```yaml
    [docker-ce, docker-ce-cli, containerd.io, docker-buildx-plugin, docker-compose-plugin, nvidia-,
      libnvidia-, incus, tailscale]
    ```

### `base_hold_kernel`

Derived; hold the kernel (bare metal unless allow_kernel_updates).

- Type: `bool`
- Default: `{{ pokus_provider == 'baremetal' and not (allow_kernel_updates | bool) }}`

### `base_kernel_package_patterns`

Kernel package patterns for apt.

- Type: `list` of `str`
- Default: `[linux-image-, linux-headers-, linux-modules-]`

### `base_kernel_package_patterns_rpm`

Kernel package patterns for dnf.

- Type: `list` of `str`
- Default: `[kernel*]`

### `base_sysctl`

Kernel settings in /etc/sysctl.d/60-pokus.conf.

- Type: `dict`
- Default:

    ```yaml
    {fs.inotify.max_user_watches: 1048576, fs.inotify.max_user_instances: 8192, net.ipv4.ip_forward: 1}
    ```

## bootstrap_signal

Stop the play with a bootstrap signal.

Entry points: `main` (Stop the play with a bootstrap signal). Role README: `ansible/roles/bootstrap_signal/README.md`.

### `bootstrap_signal_code`

75 WSL restart required, 76 reboot or MOK enrollment required, 77 operator action required.

- Type: `int`
- Choices: `75`, `76`, `77`
- Required, no default

### `bootstrap_signal_message`

What the operator has to do; printed by bootstrap.sh.

- Type: `str`
- Required, no default

### `bootstrap_signal_file`

Signal file; bootstrap.sh passes its path in pokus_bootstrap.signal_file.

- Type: `path`
- Default: `{{ pokus_bootstrap.signal_file | default('/run/pokus/bootstrap-signal.json') }}`

## deploy_source

Install the deployment helper and fetch the Pokus repository into the root-only bare mirror.

Entry points: `main` (Install the deployment helper and fetch the Pokus repository into the root-only bare mirror), `deploy` (Extract one component at a ref into its deployment directory with DEPLOYED_FROM.json), `activate` (Point the deployment root's current link at a prepared deployment, atomically). Role README: `ansible/roles/deploy_source/README.md`.

Variables the role reads from elsewhere:

| Variable | Set by | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `machine_name` | [lab-wide](#machine_name) | Machine name, the comment of the deploy key. |
| `pokus_allowed_signers` | [lab-wide](#pokus_allowed_signers) | ssh-keygen allowed_signers lines for signed tags. |
| `pokus_source_known_hosts` | [lab-wide](#pokus_source_known_hosts) | Extra known_hosts lines for an SSH source. |
| `pokus_source_repo` | [lab-wide](#pokus_source_repo) | SSH or anonymous HTTPS URL of the deployer's copy of the Pokus repository (owner answer E3). |
| `pokus_versions` | host_vars | The pinned versions (GitHub's SSH host keys). |
| `require_signed_tags` | [lab-wide](#require_signed_tags) | Deploy only validly SSH-signed component tags (owner answer E16). |

### `deploy_source_component`

Component to deploy (its subdirectory of the repository).

- Type: `str`

- Default: `''`

### `deploy_source_ref`

A component tag, another tag, a branch or a full commit.

- Type: `str`
- Default: `''`
- Entry points: `deploy`, `activate`

### `deploy_source_root`

Deployment root (/srv/pokus/deploy/platform or /srv/pokus/catalog).

- Type: `path`
- Default: `''`
- Entry points: `deploy`, `activate`

### `deploy_source_owner`

Owner of the deployed tree.

- Type: `str`
- Default: `root`
- Entry points: `deploy`

### `deploy_source_group`

Group of the deployed tree.

- Type: `str`
- Default: `root`
- Entry points: `deploy`

### `deploy_source_dir_mode`

Mode of directories and executable files.

### `deploy_source_file_mode`

Mode of other files.

- Type: `str`

### `deploy_source_name`

## doctor

The pokus-lab operator CLI, a copy of preflight it runs, and the lab description /etc/pokus/lab.json.

Entry points: `main` (The pokus-lab operator CLI, a copy of preflight it runs, and the lab description /etc/pokus/lab.json). Role README: `ansible/roles/doctor/README.md`.

Variables the role reads from elsewhere:

| Variable | Set by | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `host_profile` | bootstrap.sh | The validated host profile (storage backend of the Incus pool). |
| `machine` | bootstrap.sh | Name of the host_vars file (bootstrap --machine); pokus-lab passes it back to bootstrap. |
| `machine_name` | [lab-wide](#machine_name) | Machine name; the Tailscale host name doctor expects. |
| `node_role` | [lab-wide](#node_role) | full, lab or inference; selects the units, containers and Incus, PostgreSQL and image checks. |
| `pokus_features` | host_vars | Feature flags of the host profile (gpu_inference, vm_targets). |
| `pokus_infra_dir` | host_vars | Infra directory of the checkout bootstrap runs from; the sources of the CLI and the blueprints. |
| `pokus_provider` | host_vars | Provider of this host (WSL checks, sleep inhibitor, nvidia-smi path). |
| `pokus_versions` | host_vars | The pinned versions (the image and digest every lab container must run). |

### `doctor_max_clock_offset`

Largest clock offset doctor accepts, in seconds.

- Type: `float`
- Default: `1.0`

### `doctor_min_pool_free_gib`

Free space of the Incus pool below which doctor warns, in GiB.

- Type: `int`
- Default: `20`

### `doctor_backup_max_age_hours`

Age of the last successful backup after which doctor warns, in hours.

- Type: `int`
- Default: `26`

### `doctor_telemetry_wait`

Seconds doctor waits for its telemetry probe to arrive in Loki, Tempo and Prometheus.

- Type: `int`
- Default: `60`

### `doctor_smoke_wait`

Seconds doctor --smoke waits for a throwaway target's logs in Loki.

- Type: `int`
- Default: `120`

### `doctor_certificate_renew_days`

Days before a pairing certificate expires at which doctor fails inference.pairing.

- Type: `int`
- Default: `30`

### `doctor_drain_timeout`

Seconds `pokus-lab update-host` gives the orchestrator to drain.

- Type: `int`
- Default: `1800`

### `doctor_listener_processes`

Processes that may listen outside loopback (names as `ss -p` shows them).

- Type: `list` of `str`

## firewall

Firewall policy with the nftables, firewalld or ufw backend.

Entry points: `main` (Firewall policy with the nftables, firewalld or ufw backend). Role README: `ansible/roles/firewall/README.md`.

Variables the role reads from elsewhere:

| Variable | Set by | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `grafana_tailscale_serve` | [lab-wide](#grafana_tailscale_serve) | Open the Grafana serve port on the tailnet interface. |
| `inference_remote_node` | [lab-wide](#inference_remote_node) | The paired inference node of a lab node; its telemetry arrives on OTLP gRPC. |
| `node_role` | [lab-wide](#node_role) | Inference nodes and paired lab nodes open the split-inference ports. |
| `pokus_incus_bridge_patterns` | [lab-wide](#pokus_incus_bridge_patterns) | Interface name patterns of Incus bridges (run networks and the build bridge). |
| `pokus_incus_personal_bridge_patterns` | [lab-wide](#pokus_incus_personal_bridge_patterns) | Interface name patterns of the bridges of personal Incus projects. |
| `pokus_ports` | [lab-wide](#pokus_ports) | Contract ports (vllm, inference_control, otlp_grpc). |
| `pokus_vm_otlp` | [lab-wide](#pokus_vm_otlp) | Interface and address of the collector listener for VM targets (C4). |
| `ssh_extra_allowed_interfaces` | [lab-wide](#ssh_extra_allowed_interfaces) | Interfaces besides tailscale0 on which SSH is reachable. |

### `firewall_tailnet_interface`

Tailnet interface.

- Type: `str`
- Default: `tailscale0`

### `firewall_grafana_serve_port`

TCP port of `tailscale serve` for Grafana.

- Type: `int`
- Default: `443`

### `firewall_tailnet_tcp_ports`

TCP ports open on the tailnet interface (derived: 22, the serve port if enabled, 18704 and 18710 on an inference node, 4317 on a paired lab node).

- Type: `list` of `int`
- Default:

    ```jinja
    {{ [22]
       + ([firewall_grafana_serve_port] if grafana_tailscale_serve | bool else [])
       + ([pokus_ports.vllm, pokus_ports.inference_control] if node_role == 'inference' else [])
       + ([pokus_ports.otlp_grpc] if node_role == 'lab' and inference_remote_node | length > 0 else []) }}
    ```

### `firewall_tailscale_udp_port`

UDP port of the WireGuard transport of tailscaled.

- Type: `int`
- Default: `41641`

### `firewall_run_bridge_pattern`

Name pattern of the per-run networks; nothing is forwarded out of them.

- Type: `str`
- Default: `r-*`

### `firewall_vm_otlp_ports`

OTLP ports VM targets may reach on the listener address (derived; empty without vm_targets).

- Type: `list` of `int`
- Default:

    ```jinja
    {{ [pokus_ports.otlp_grpc, pokus_ports.otlp_http]
       if (pokus_features.vm_targets | default(false)) and node_role in ['full', 'lab'] else [] }}
    ```

### `firewall_incus_bridge_patterns`

Every Incus bridge that may use DHCP and DNS on the host (derived).

- Type: `list` of `str`
- Default: `{{ pokus_incus_bridge_patterns + pokus_incus_personal_bridge_patterns }}`

### `firewall_uplink_bridge_patterns`

Incus bridges with NAT and an uplink, trusted as Incus documents (derived).

- Type: `list` of `str`
- Default: `{{ ['pokus-build0'] + pokus_incus_personal_bridge_patterns }}`

## images

Build, test, leakage-lint, publish and export the golden images of images/.

Entry points: `main` (Build, test, leakage-lint, publish and export the golden images of images/). Role README: `ansible/roles/images/README.md`.

Variables the role reads from elsewhere:

| Variable | Set by | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pokus_bootstrap` | bootstrap.sh | Bootstrap options; repo_commit and infra_dirty become the pokus.recipe_commit property. |
| `pokus_infra_dir` | host_vars | Infra directory of the checkout (images/ recipes). |
| `pokus_root` | [lab-wide](#pokus_root) | Research space root; the exports go to its images/ directory. |
| `pokus_versions` | host_vars | The pinned versions (generated group_vars versions.yml): the base images, the agent and the target container images. |

### `images_blueprints`

Blueprints to build, in build order (a base blueprint before the blueprints that start from it).

- Type: `list` of `str`
- Default: `[_base, web-nginx-flask, pg-primary, redis-cache, docker-host, probe-client]`

### `images_rebuild`

Build the listed blueprints again although their alias and export exist; the new image replaces the alias and the export of the same version.

- Type: `bool`
- Default: `false`

### `images_export_root`

Root of the exports, &lt;blueprint&gt;/&lt;version&gt;/ and _upstream/&lt;base&gt;/&lt;fingerprint&gt;/ (pokus_root/images).

- Type: `path`
- Default: `{{ pokus_root }}/images`

### `images_project`

Incus project of the build instances.

- Type: `str`
- Default: `build`

### `images_profile`

Incus profile of the build instances.

- Type: `str`
- Default: `build`

### `images_boot_timeout`

Seconds to wait for cloud-init in a new build instance.

- Type: `int`
- Default: `900`

### `images_leakage_paths`

Directories whose file names and contents the leakage lint checks (unit names, the host name and .git directories are always checked).

- Type: `list` of `str`
- Default: `[/etc, /opt, /srv, /usr/local]`

### `images_leakage_patterns`

Python regular expressions that fail the build when the build adds a match.

- Type: `list` of `str`
- Default:

    ```yaml
    ['[A-Z]+-[0-9]{3}', '(?i)fault', '(?i)inject', '(?i)ground[_-]?truth', '(?i)scenario']
    ```

### `images_leakage_allow`

Benign words ({match, optional path}, regular expressions) cut out of a finding before the patterns are applied again.

- Type: `list` of `dict`
- Default:

    ```yaml
    - {match: '(?i)default'}
    - {match: '(?i)scenarios?', path: etc/redis/redis\.conf}
    ```

## incus

Incus LTS with the pool, networks, run ACL, projects, profiles and service certificates.

Entry points: `main` (Incus LTS with the pool, networks, run ACL, projects, profiles and service certificates). Role README: `ansible/roles/incus/README.md`.

Variables the role reads from elsewhere:

| Variable | Set by | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `host_profile` | bootstrap.sh | Host profile (storage_backend, hardware) passed by bootstrap. |
| `pokus_bootstrap` | bootstrap.sh | Bootstrap options (adopt_incus, interactive). |
| `pokus_infra_dir` | host_vars | Infra directory of the checkout (incus/ templates). |
| `pokus_vm_otlp` | [lab-wide](#pokus_vm_otlp) | Interface and address of the collector listener for VM targets (C4). |
| `researchers` | [lab-wide](#researchers) | Researchers; each gets a personal project and joins the Incus user group. |

### `incus_pool_name`

Storage pool of all instances.

- Type: `str`
- Default: `pokus-targets`

### `incus_pool_source`

A loop file in the root filesystem, or a dedicated device.

- Type: `str`
- Choices: `loop`, `device`
- Default: `loop`

### `incus_pool_size`

Size of a loop pool.

- Type: `str`
- Default: `300GiB`

### `incus_pool_device`

Dedicated device for the pool (use /dev/disk/by-id/...).

- Type: `str`
- Default: `''`

### `incus_pool_device_confirm`

Must repeat incus_pool_device exactly, or nothing is formatted.

- Type: `str`
- Default: `''`

### `incus_pool_device_force_wipe`

Format the device even though it carries a filesystem, LVM or RAID signature.

- Type: `bool`
- Default: `false`

### `incus_https_address`

Address of the Incus HTTPS API (restricted TLS clients and metrics).

- Type: `str`
- Default: `127.0.0.1:8443`

### `incus_build_network`

NAT bridge of the build project.

- Type: `str`
- Default: `pokus-build0`

### `incus_run_acl`

Network ACL the platform attaches to every run network.

- Type: `str`
- Default: `pokus-run-default`

### `incus_run_acl_egress`

Egress rules of the run ACL (derived; OTLP to the VM listener with vm_targets).

- Type: `list` of `dict`
- Default:

    ```jinja
    {{ [{'action': 'allow', 'state': 'enabled', 'protocol': 'tcp',
         'destination': pokus_vm_otlp.address ~ '/32',
         'destination_port': pokus_ports.otlp_grpc ~ ',' ~ pokus_ports.otlp_http,
         'description': 'OTLP to the collector listener for VM targets'}]
       if pokus_features.vm_targets | default(false) else [] }}
    ```

### `incus_max_virtual_machines`

Most VMs at once in the bench and build projects (with the vm_targets feature).

- Type: `int`
- Default: `4`

### `incus_bench_limits`

Project limits of bench (derived from the host's memory and CPUs).

- Type: `dict`
- Default:

    ```yaml
    {limits.memory: '{{ [((host_profile.hardware.memory_gib | float) * 0.6) | int, 1] | max }}GiB',
      limits.cpu: '{{ [(host_profile.hardware.cpu_threads_effective | int) - 2, 1] | max }}',
      limits.instances: '40'}
    ```

### `incus_target_container`

Default limits and root disk of the target-container profile.

- Type: `dict`
- Default: `{cpu: '1', memory: 1GiB, root_size: 8GiB}`

### `incus_target_vm`

Default limits and root disk of the target-vm profile.

- Type: `dict`
- Default: `{cpu: '2', memory: 2GiB, root_size: 16GiB}`

### `incus_probe_client`

Limits and root disk of the probe-client profile.

- Type: `dict`
- Default: `{cpu: '1', memory: 512MiB, root_size: 4GiB}`

### `incus_build_instance`

Limits and root disk of the build profile.

- Type: `dict`
- Default: `{cpu: '2', memory: 2GiB, root_size: 16GiB}`

### `incus_user_limits`

Project limits of each personal project.

- Type: `dict`
- Default:

    ```yaml
    {limits.instances: '5', limits.cpu: '4', limits.memory: 8GiB, limits.disk: 60GiB}
    ```

### `incus_user_instance`

Default limits and root disk of instances in personal projects.

- Type: `dict`
- Default: `{cpu: '1', memory: 1GiB, root_size: 10GiB}`

### `incus_cert_dir`

Directory of the client certificates (one subdirectory per service).

- Type: `path`
- Default: `/etc/pokus/incus`

### `incus_service_certificates`

Platform services that get a restricted client certificate ({account, short, projects}).

- Type: `list` of `dict`
- Default:

    ```yaml
    - account: pokus-orch
      short: orch
      projects: [bench, build]
    - account: pokus-exec
      short: exec
      projects: [bench]
    - account: pokus-inject
      short: inject
      projects: [bench]
    - account: pokus-verify
      short: verify
      projects: [bench]
    ```

### `incus_metrics_certificate`

The metrics-only certificate for Prometheus.

- Type: `dict`
- Default: `{account: root, short: metrics, type: metrics}`

### `incus_certificate_days`

Validity of generated client certificates in days.

- Type: `int`
- Default: `3650`

### `incus_events_identifier`

Journal identifier of the Incus event feed.

- Type: `str`
- Default: `pokus-incus-events`

- Entry points: `main`

### `platform_settings`

Non-secret settings per service short name, rendered into /etc/pokus/platform/&lt;svc&gt;.toml and checked against the platform's schemas (C9b).

- Type: `dict`
- Default: `{}`
- Entry points: `main`

### `platform_inference_mode`

Inference backend of endpoints.toml; auto is local where this node serves inference, otherwise remote.

- Type: `str`
- Choices: `auto`, `local`, `remote`, `scripted`
- Default: `auto`
- Entry points: `main`

### `platform_scripted_api_url`

OpenAI-compatible endpoint of the scripted backend (staging only, D3).

- Type: `str`
- Default: `''`
- Entry points: `main`

## platform_facts

Derive the platform facts from the host profile.

Entry points: `main` (Derive the platform facts from the host profile). Role README: `ansible/roles/platform_facts/README.md`.

Variables the role reads from elsewhere:

| Variable | Set by | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `allow_community_repos` | [lab-wide](#allow_community_repos) | Consent to community repositories (COPR, OBS, RPM Fusion); also set by --allow-community-repos. |
| `firewall_backend` | [lab-wide](#firewall_backend) | Firewall backend; auto selects firewalld if active, else ufw if active, else nftables. |
| `host_profile` | bootstrap.sh | Host profile written by preflight, passed by bootstrap.sh. |
| `lab_provider` | [lab-wide](#lab_provider) | Provider; auto takes it from the host profile, an explicit value must match it. |

## postgres

PostgreSQL on Unix sockets with the contract's roles, schemas and revokes.

Entry points: `main` (PostgreSQL on Unix sockets with the contract's roles, schemas and revokes). Role README: `ansible/roles/postgres/README.md`.

Variables the role reads from elsewhere:

| Variable | Set by | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `host_profile` | bootstrap.sh | Host profile (hardware.memory_gib sizes the memory settings). |
| `pokus_infra_dir` | host_vars | Infra directory of the checkout (config/postgres/*.j2). |
| `vault_postgres_passwords` | host_vars | Passwords of the platform, reader and Grafana roles (vault; printable ASCII). |

### `postgres_shared_buffers`

shared_buffers (default 1/16 of the memory, 128 MB to 4 GB).

- Type: `str`
- Default: `{{ [[(host_profile.hardware.memory_gib * 64) | int, 128] | max, 4096] | min }}MB`

### `postgres_effective_cache_size`

effective_cache_size (default 1/4 of the memory, 512 MB to 16 GB).

- Type: `str`
- Default: `{{ [[(host_profile.hardware.memory_gib * 256) | int, 512] | max, 16384] | min }}MB`

### `postgres_max_connections`

max_connections.

- Type: `int`
- Default: `100`

### `postgres_container_uid`

UID of the postgres user in the pinned image.

- Type: `int`
- Default: `999`

### `postgres_container_gid`

GID of the postgres user in the pinned image.

- Type: `int`
- Default: `999`

### `postgres_exporter_uid`

UID of the exporter container (nobody).

- Type: `int`
- Default: `65534`

### `postgres_container`

Name of the PostgreSQL container.

- Type: `str`
- Default: `pokus-postgres`

### `postgres_state_dir`

Data directory on the host (pokus_root/state/postgres).

- Type: `path`
- Default: `{{ pokus_root }}/state/postgres`

### `postgres_config_dir`

Rendered configuration (pokus_root/services/core/config/postgres).

- Type: `path`
- Default: `{{ pokus_root }}/services/core/config/postgres`

### `postgres_service_roles`

Platform roles with a password file and the file's owner, group and mode.

- Type: `list` of `dict`
- Default:

    ```yaml
    - {role: pokus_migrator, owner: root, group: root, mode: '0600'}
    - {role: pokus_orch, owner: root, group: pokus-orch, mode: '0640'}
    - {role: pokus_gw, owner: root, group: pokus-gw, mode: '0640'}
    - {role: pokus_exec, owner: root, group: pokus-exec, mode: '0640'}
    - {role: pokus_inject, owner: root, group: pokus-inject, mode: '0640'}
    - {role: pokus_verify, owner: root, group: pokus-verify, mode: '0640'}
    - {role: pokus_eval, owner: root, group: pokus-eval, mode: '0640'}
    ```

### `postgres_reader_role`

Researchers' read-only role.

- Type: `str`
- Default: `pokus_reader`

### `postgres_grafana_role`

Grafana's read-only role.

- Type: `str`
- Default: `pokus_grafana`

### `postgres_monitor_role`

Role of the metrics exporter (pg_monitor).

- Type: `str`
- Default: `pokus_monitor`

## preflight_gate

Re-run preflight and stop if the host changed.

Entry points: `main` (Re-run preflight and stop if the host changed). Role README: `ansible/roles/preflight_gate/README.md`.

Variables the role reads from elsewhere:

| Variable | Set by | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `host_profile` | bootstrap.sh | Host profile validated by bootstrap.sh for this run. |
| `pokus_root` | [lab-wide](#pokus_root) | Research space; preflight measures its free disk space. |

### `preflight_gate_command`

Preflight wrapper of this checkout.

- Type: `path`
- Default: `{{ pokus_infra_dir }}/preflight/pokus-preflight`

### `preflight_gate_profile_path`

Profile to compare with; bootstrap passes the profile it validated (pokus_bootstrap.profile_path).

- Type: `path`
- Default: `{{ pokus_bootstrap.profile_path | default('/etc/pokus/host-profile.json') }}`

## provider_baremetal

Bare-metal provider.

Entry points: `main` (Bare-metal provider). Role README: `ansible/roles/provider_baremetal/README.md`.

| Variable | Set by | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |

Targets masked by never_sleep.

Command that rebuilds the initramfs, per pokus_initramfs_tool.

    ```yaml
    update-initramfs: [update-initramfs, -u, -k, all]
    dracut: [dracut, --force, --regenerate-all]

    ```

## provider_wsl2

WSL2 provider.

Entry points: `main` (WSL2 provider), `post_layout` (Render the recommended .wslconfig into the research space). Role README: `ansible/roles/provider_wsl2/README.md`.

Variables the role reads from elsewhere:

| Variable | Set by | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `expected` | host_vars | host_vars `expected` (memory_gib, cpu_threads). |
| `host_profile` | bootstrap.sh | Host profile (init.systemd, gpu.present). |
| `machine_name` | [lab-wide](#machine_name) | Host name written to wsl.conf. |
| `pokus_root` | [lab-wide](#pokus_root) | Research space; the file goes to services/contrib/wslconfig.recommended. |

### `provider_wsl2_automount`

[automount] enabled: mount Windows drives under /mnt.

- Type: `bool`
- Default: `false`
- Entry points: `main`

### `provider_wsl2_mount_fstab`

[automount] mountFsTab.

- Type: `bool`
- Default: `false`
- Entry points: `main`

### `provider_wsl2_interop`

[interop] enabled: run Windows executables from Linux.

- Type: `bool`
- Default: `false`
- Entry points: `main`

### `provider_wsl2_append_windows_path`

[interop] appendWindowsPath.

- Type: `bool`
- Default: `false`
- Entry points: `main`

### `provider_wsl2_generate_hosts`

[network] generateHosts.

- Type: `bool`
- Default: `true`
- Entry points: `main`

### `provider_wsl2_generate_resolv_conf`

[network] generateResolvConf.

- Type: `bool`
- Default: `true`
- Entry points: `main`

### `provider_wsl2_distro_name`

Distribution name in the restart instruction (from WSL_DISTRO_NAME when available).

- Type: `str`
- Default: `{{ ansible_facts['env']['WSL_DISTRO_NAME'] | default('<distro>') }}`
- Entry points: `main`

### `provider_wsl2_default_memory_gib`

Memory in the recommendation when `expected.memory_gib` is not set.

- Type: `int`
- Default: `16`
- Entry points: `post_layout`

### `provider_wsl2_default_cpu_threads`

Processors in the recommendation when `expected.cpu_threads` is not set.

- Type: `int`
- Default: `8`
- Entry points: `post_layout`

### `provider_wsl2_swap_gib`

Swap in the recommendation.

- Type: `int`
- Default: `8`
- Entry points: `post_layout`

## tailscale

Install Tailscale, join the tailnet with the lab's tag, check that Funnel is off.

Entry points: `main` (Install Tailscale, join the tailnet with the lab's tag, check that Funnel is off). Role README: `ansible/roles/tailscale/README.md`.

Variables the role reads from elsewhere:

| Variable | Set by | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `grafana_tailscale_serve` | [lab-wide](#grafana_tailscale_serve) | Publish Grafana on the tailnet with `tailscale serve` (never Funnel). |
| `lab_mode` | [lab-wide](#lab_mode) | Selects the tag (tag:pokus-lab or tag:pokus-qa). |
| `machine_name` | [lab-wide](#machine_name) | Host name on the tailnet. |

### `tailscale_tag`

Advertised tag; derived from lab_mode.

- Type: `str`
- Default: `{{ pokus_tailscale_tags[lab_mode] }}`

### `tailscale_accept_dns`

Let MagicDNS change host name resolution.

- Type: `bool`
- Default: `false`

### `tailscale_up_argv`

Arguments of `tailscale up` (without the auth key).

- Type: `list` of `str`
- Default:

    ```yaml
    [tailscale, up, '--hostname={{ machine_name }}', '--advertise-tags={{ tailscale_tag }}', '--accept-dns={{
        tailscale_accept_dns | bool | lower }}', --ssh=false]
    ```

### `tailscale_login_timeout`

Seconds to wait for an interactive login.

- Type: `int`
- Default: `600`

### `tailscale_grafana_serve_port`

HTTPS port of the Grafana serve.

- Type: `int`
- Default: `443`
